A '''Human''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. They were opposed to [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] unorthodox explorations of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
